newsitem.title: USA: Intl Paper sees demand increasing H2 profits.
newsitem.headline: Intl Paper sees demand increasing H2 profits.

text.p: International Paper said Tuesday it expected better industry conditions to lead to increased profitablity in the second half of the year.

"These second-quarter results continue the favorable trend in industry conditions that we began to see earlier this year," said John Dillon, International Paper's chairman and chief executive officer.
"The good demand we are experiencing should lead to increased profitability over the next six months."
International Paper said Tuesday it lost $1.39 a share in the second quarter after a $685 million charge, vs a $0.33 per share profit in the second quarter last year.
Excluding the charges, International Paper reported a second-quarter operating profit of $0.20 per share.
